# Data samples, field by field

One page per data type: a real record of the committed test data, pretty-printed, and every field of it explained from the type's data contract, so a production query or ETL job can emit exactly this JSON Lines shape. Each page gives the file layout (path, key and date fields, promoted and vector columns, snapshot or changes), one fully explained record of each sub-type, the fields only other rows have, and a checklist for the query author. The meanings come from the contracts ([packs/README.md](../packs/README.md)); the pages are generated by `tools/testdata/sample_docs.py` and checked by `tools/test_sample_docs.py`, so they follow the data and the contracts.

85 pages: what a bank produces, grouped as it produces them; then the kinds Drishti computes, which you never send. *Needed for* says which kinds VaR and exposure cannot work without.

## Market-risk inputs (VaR)

**You produce this.** Test data under `data/testdata/`.

During the day the same scenario-PV and P&L-vector records may also arrive on Kafka (the PV topic, connector `pv-updates`): each message's value is JSON Lines of exactly these records.

| Kind | Command | Test data | Rows | Needed for | What one record is |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [`scenario-pv`](market-risk/scenario-pv.md) | `SPV` | `market-risk/scenario-pv/`, one full file set per date | 1,346 | **VaR: required** (each trade as scenario PVs or as a P&L vector) | A trade's present value under each historical scenario and its base PV of the same run, in the trade's own currency: the form of a trade's scenario P&L a bank may send instead of a P&L vector (; VAR_GUIDE.md section 15.9). The VaR engine turns it into the trade's USD P&L when it loads the date: P&L(s) = PV(s) x FX(s) - PV(base) x FX(base). |
| [`pnl-vector`](market-risk/pnl-vector.md) | `PNLV` | `market-risk/pnl-vector/`, one full file set per date | 8,235 | **VaR: required** (each trade as a P&L vector or as scenario PVs) | One trade's (or one position's) P&L under every scenario of the date's scenario set, gain positive, in CURRENCY, with the terms the VaR engine places it by. |
| [`scenario-set`](market-risk/scenario-set.md) | `SSET` | `market-risk/scenario-set/`, one full file set per date | 1 | **VaR: required** (orders every vector) | The historical scenario days of a business date, oldest first: index i of every P&L vector, scenario-PV vector and FX scenario of the date is SCENARIO_DATES[i]. |
| [`fx-scenario`](market-risk/fx-scenario.md) | `FXS` | `market-risk/fx-scenario/`, one full file set per date | 6 | **VaR: required** for scenario PVs not in USD, unless fx-spot holds 510 days of history | A currency's rate against USD today and under each historical scenario, as the risk batch supplies it (; VAR_GUIDE.md section 15.9): the VaR engine converts scenario PVs and reporting currencies with it. A currency the batch does not supply is derived from the FX history (fx-spot). |
| [`risk-hierarchy`](market-risk/risk-hierarchy.md) | `HIER` | `market-risk/risk-hierarchy/`, one full file set per date | 88 | **VaR: required** for the MGMT and LEGAL hierarchies | One node of a VaR hierarchy (MGMT or LEGAL): its level, parent, children, the books under it and its VaR limit. |
| [`portfolio`](market-risk/portfolio.md) | `PORT` | `market-risk/portfolio/`, one full file set per date | 28 | VaR: optional (stored portfolios) | A portfolio in terms of the positions inside it: longs and shorts, market value, VaR, ES and each position's contribution. |
| [`var-limit`](market-risk/var-limit.md) | `VLIM` | `market-risk/var-limit/`, one full file set per date | 157 | VaR: optional (limits of the column-built hierarchies) | The 1-day 99% VaR limit of one node of a hierarchy, keyed by the hierarchy and the node's id, in USD |

## Computed by Drishti: you do not produce these

These kinds have a contract but no page: Drishti computes or derives them from the kinds above when asked (or when a load lands), and a bank never sends them.

| Pack | Kind | Command | Class | Where it comes from |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| compute-demo | `path-sum` | `PSUM` | Drishti computes this | Book path (Python) (the path-sum kind of the compute-demo pack) |
| compute-demo | `path-sum-java` | `PSUMJ` | Drishti computes this | Book path (Java) (the path-sum-java kind of the compute-demo pack) |
| counterparty-risk | `exposure-result` | `EXP` | Drishti computes this | The exposure profile (EE, ENE, EEE, PFE at 95% and 99%, EE without collateral) and the figures (CE, EPE, EEPE, peak EE and PFE, EAD under the internal model) of any counterparty scope (the scope grammar of EXPOSURE_GUIDE.md section 4), computed when asked by the server's exposure engine from the simulated paths, as the person asking; never stored. |
| counterparty-risk | `exposure-whatif` | `XWIF` | Drishti computes this | A scope's exposure before and after candidate trades kept in the person's private sandbox, by the exact paths method (each candidate's values on every path of the day's run added to its netting set, collateral and exposure computed again), computed when asked by the Python exposure engine from the scope's exposure-result; never stored. |
| counterparty-risk | `exposure-official-cpty` | `XOFC` | Drishti computes this | The official end-of-day exposure (current exposure, EPE, effective EPE, peak EE, peak PFE at 95% and 99%) of every netting set, counterparty and connected group, as the server captured and published it (one row per scope, business date and result version); read only, for BI and other readers, never an engine's input. |
| counterparty-risk | `nset-mtm` | `NSMTM` | Drishti computes this | A netting set's MtM totals derived from the trade valuations of its live trades, once per business date, shown beside the netting set's stored figures (quick win Q1 of docs/architecture/COMPUTED_ATTRIBUTES.md, until the netting-set engine computes them). |
| counterparty-risk | `cpty-mtm` | `CPMTM` | Drishti computes this | A counterparty's MtM totals derived from the trade valuations of its live trades in netting sets, once per business date, shown beside the counterparty's stored NET_MTM (quick win Q2 of docs/architecture/COMPUTED_ATTRIBUTES.md). |
| gleif | `lei-group` | `LEIG` | Drishti computes this | An ownership group, computed from the entities when asked: the ultimate parent with its whole tree, every member, and counts by country and legal form. |
| gleif | `lei-country` | `LEIC` | Drishti computes this | A country's legal entities in the pack, computed from the entities when asked: the entities, the groups present, legal forms and cities. |
| market-data | `correlation-result` | `CORRC` | Drishti computes this | The pairwise correlations of a correlation set's factors, computed when asked from their daily closes in the lake (log returns over a window, Pearson or Ledoit-Wolf) by the server's Java engine, as the person asking; never stored. |
| market-data | `equity-beta` | `EQB` | Drishti computes this | An equity's beta, alpha, correlation and R squared against its index (EQUITY_INDEX), the regression of their daily log returns over a window, computed when asked from both price histories by the server's Java engine, as the person asking; never stored. It replaces the security master's stored BETA (retired). |
| market-risk | `position` | `POS` | Drishti derives this | A position: one security held in one book (or one OTC trade), the trades that build or reduce it, and its VaR computed as the page opens. |
| market-risk | `var-result` | `VRES` | Drishti computes this | The VaR, ES, decomposition, worst scenarios and P&L vector of any scope (the scope grammar of VAR_GUIDE.md section 5), computed when asked by the server's VaR engine as the person asking; never stored. |
| market-risk | `var-whatif` | `VWIF` | Drishti computes this | A scope's VaR and ES before and after hypothetical trades kept in the person's private sandbox, and its stressed window, computed when asked by the Python VaR engine from the scope's var-result; never stored. |
| market-risk | `var-official` | `VOFF` | Drishti computes this | The official end-of-day VaR and ES of every node of the MGMT and LEGAL hierarchies, as the server captured and published them (one row per node, business date and result version); read only, for BI and other readers, never an engine's input. |
| market-risk | `stress-scenario-pnl` | `SSPNL` | Drishti computes this | The bank's stress P&L under one scenario: the desks' stored stress results added (additive), with each desk's limit use and breach, once per business date (quick win Q4 of docs/architecture/COMPUTED_ATTRIBUTES.md, until the stress engine STR). |
| trading | `counterparty-trades` | `CTRD` | Drishti computes this | Every trade with a counterparty, from every source system: its trades (every status, a status filter), upcoming payments, notional by product type and index, maturities, payments by month. |
| trading | `portfolio-trades` | `PTRD` | Drishti computes this | Every trade of a portfolio (book), from every source system: its trades (every status, a status filter), upcoming payments, notional by product type and index, maturities, payments by month. |
| trading | `legal-entity-trades` | `LTRD` | Drishti computes this | Every trade a legal entity of the bank booked, from every source system: its trades (every status, a status filter), upcoming payments, notional by product type and index, maturities, payments by month. |
| trading | `index-trades` | `ITRD` | Drishti computes this | Every trade with a leg on an index (the first leg that names one): its trades (every status, a status filter), upcoming payments, notional by product type and index, maturities, payments by month. |
| us-equities | `sic-sector` | `SIC` | Drishti computes this | A sector by its SIC code, computed from the companies when asked: its companies ranked by revenue; a click opens a company's summary beside. |
| us-equities | `price-history` | `PXH` | fetched by Drishti | A company's quote and a year of daily prices, read live by the us-equities-prices connector: off as shipped, internal use only. |
| world-economy | `country-group` | `ECG` | Drishti computes this | A World Bank region or income group (or the world), computed from its member economies when asked: output, population, growth, inflation and its largest economies. |
